classification.label: Independently Verified Robustness Characterization
classification.wording_rule: this campaign may be reported as Robustness Characterization; the wording Independently Verified Robustness Characterization is only earned once the independent per-sample re-flight is CHECKED, covers the samples the verdicts rest on, and every sample agrees with the main model within the declared bands (task #412 acceptance). It says the EVIDENCE is independent, not that the design is robust or safe: see `outcome` for the success rate
classification.outcome: the evidence is independent; the design it characterizes succeeds on 13/264 hold-out samples (4.9%, cluster CI 2.7%-7.6%) under these criteria. No success-rate requirement is declared, so this records the rate; it does NOT show the design robust to the declared dispersions

grading.definition: success = arrival inside tolerances, no safety violation on the flown trajectory, AND every passive contingency release (no-burn at t0, gate abort at t1, hold-point coast) stays outside the keep-out corridor for its whole duration

baseline_e12_07.grading: arrival + safety checks, passive contingencies NOT in success

selection.description: every success (cap 16); passive-contingency failures, passive-only first (cap 8); one boundary sample per failure class (smallest distance to its governing threshold); one planning_infeasible representative recorded as skipped; cap 32; deterministic by (cluster, index)

notes: time-of-flight held at the ground plan's: this prices a locked mission design, not a per-sample re-optimisation (the latter costs ~9 s/sample for a delta-v change E12-05 measured as flat across the window)
the truth grid is campaign.sample_dt_s, coarser than the config's check_sample_dt_s by design; grid_convergence measures whether it can move a verdict
drag is present in the truth model whenever the source is enabled: the plan ignores the atmosphere, and the lognormal factor prices what is unknown about it
the independent-model line is the E12-05 TudatPy re-flight and is recorded not_checked wherever no backend is available (REFLY_BACKEND_MISSING)
